tool.name: Pairtools merge

param.name: pairs_path
param.label: Input pairs files
param.help: One or more sorted .pairs or .pairsam files to merge

param.name: output
param.label: Output filename
param.help: Specify the name of the output merged file

param.name: keep_first_header
param.label: Keep first header instead of merging
param.help: Keep only the first header of the inputs

param.name: concatenate
param.label: Concatenate instead of merge
param.help: Simply concatenate files instead of merging sorted inputs

param.name: max_nmerge
param.label: Maximum number of inputs to merge at once
param.help: Advanced: Maximal number of inputs merged at once. For more, intermediate files are created.

tool.help:
**Pairtools merge**
Merge sorted .pairs or .pairsam files. By default, files are assumed to be triu-flipped and sorted. Headers are merged unless the 'Keep first header' option is selected. Multiple input files can be merged in batches using the 'Maximum number of inputs' advanced option.
Original authors: Open2C, Pairtools contributors
